CaseSensitive.description: Whether the comparison is case sensitive. Defaults to false.

$type.description: Ends with. Matches when the value ends with the comparison text. Fixed '$type' for the 'StringEndsWithOperator' operator.

CaseSensitive.description: Whether the comparison is case sensitive. Defaults to false.

$type.description: Equals. Matches when the value equals the comparison text. Fixed '$type' for the 'StringEqualsOperator' operator.

CaseSensitive.description: Whether the comparison is case sensitive. Defaults to false.

$type.description: Does not contain. Matches when the value does not contain the comparison text. Fixed '$type' for the 'StringNotContainsOperator' operator.

CaseSensitive.description: Whether the comparison is case sensitive. Defaults to false.

$type.description: Does not end with. Matches when the value does not end with the comparison text. Fixed '$type' for the 'StringNotEndsWithOperator' operator.

CaseSensitive.description: Whether the comparison is case sensitive. Defaults to false.

$type.description: Does not equal. Matches when the value does not equal the comparison text. Fixed '$type' for the 'StringNotEqualsOperator' operator.

CaseSensitive.description: Whether the comparison is case sensitive. Defaults to false.

$type.description: Does not start with. Matches when the value does not start with the comparison text. Fixed '$type' for the 'StringNotStartsWithOperator' operator.

CaseSensitive.description: Whether the comparison is case sensitive. Defaults to false.

$type.description: Starts with. Matches when the value starts with the comparison text. Fixed '$type' for the 'StringStartsWithOperator' operator.

CaseSensitive.description: Whether the comparison is case sensitive. Defaults to false.

Conditions.description: The conditions that make up the rule. Every top-level condition must evaluate to true for the layer to be active.

LayerRule.description: The structured rule evaluated to decide whether the layer is active for the current request.
